requirement.statement: The system SHALL expose AI workflow as an Eidolon-native capability through contract, tool, effect and profile boundaries.

case.given: The AI kernel runtime composes built-in native tools
case.when: The tool registry and model-visible tool schemas are inspected
case.then: The system SHALL include native workflow tools without requiring MCP fallback

case.given: Workflow tool implementations are added
case.when: The source layout is inspected
case.then: The implementation SHALL live under `ai-organ-logic/src/workflow/tools`, with composer code limited to bundle registration

requirement.statement: The system SHALL declare workflow-owned orchestration facts without taking ownership of existing Eidolon runtime facts.

case.given: Eidolon runtime data-subgraph contracts are loaded
case.when: The workflow contract package is imported
case.then: The workflow data-subgraph SHALL be additive and SHALL explicitly disown actor, session, conversation, tool, provider, runtime-control, checkpoint, member, holon and detached-task facts

requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide a minimal native workflow tool surface that can be called by Eidolon agents.

case.given: An agent calls the workflow capability inspection tool
case.when: The tool runs inside an Eidolon runtime
case.then: The tool SHALL return available workflow forms, fact owner boundaries and whether workflow roots are injected

case.given: An agent calls the workflow resource reference validation tool
case.when: The ref uses an allowed workflow resource scheme
case.then: The tool SHALL return a structured accepted result; unsafe refs SHALL be rejected

requirement.statement: The system SHALL consume depa-flows AI workflow contracts and profile source loaders as the authority for workflow kinds, substrates, resource refs, definition bindings and XNL diagnostics.

case.given: Eidolon workflow contracts are imported
case.when: Workflow kinds, substrates, reuse policies or definition bindings are inspected
case.then: The values and types SHALL come from depa-flows while Eidolon-specific fact ownership remains additive

case.given: Named XNL sources contain an AICtrlWorkflow or AIDataWorkflow definition
case.when: The Eidolon workflow resource loader validates the sources
case.then: The loader SHALL invoke the corresponding depa-flows profile loader and return its typed binding and structured diagnostics

case.given: The WorkflowCommandService creates a deterministic bundle draft
case.when: The draft XNL is loaded through the workflow resource loader
case.then: The draft SHALL produce a canonical definition binding without diagnostics

requirement.statement: The system SHALL expose one containment-safe workflow authoring workspace through the native component, and CLI/TUI surfaces MUST use that component for physical resource transitions.

case.given: An Eidolon agent calls a workflow authoring tool inside TUI or headless runtime
case.when: The tool creates or edits a workflow resource
case.then: The component SHALL bind the injected workflow workspace root and perform a canonical validate-write-validate transition

case.given: A user invokes an `eidolon workflow` authoring command
case.when: The command publishes workflow resources
case.then: The CLI SHALL invoke the same component command and SHALL NOT implement a private filesystem write loop

case.given: An authoring operation contains resource-relative paths
case.when: The workspace applies the transition
case.then: Traversal and absolute paths SHALL be rejected and file replacement SHALL be atomic within the workspace root

case.given: A natural-language coordinator needs to inspect or modify a workflow
case.when: It uses the component authoring workspace
case.then: The workspace SHALL provide read, tree, search, diff, write/edit, delete, validate, dry-run and publish primitives with revision evidence

requirement.statement: The system SHALL let humans create or edit canonical AI workflows using ordinary language through TUI and CLI, using Eidolon actors and component-backed native tools without external agent CLIs.

case.given: A user describes a workflow in ordinary language during an Eidolon conversation
case.when: The AI kernel routes the request
case.then: An Eidolon authoring actor SHALL select the form, generate or edit canonical XNL, run a bounded proof/repair loop and publish through WorkflowComponent

case.given: A user invokes `eidolon workflow create` or `edit` with a natural-language instruction
case.when: The command runs
case.then: The command SHALL use the in-process Eidolon runtime and the same WorkflowAuthor capability, without invoking an external AI CLI

case.given: The authoring actor needs resource facts or mutations
case.when: It inspects the native tool registry
case.then: Component-backed workspace read/tree/search/diff/validate/write/delete primitives SHALL be model-visible

requirement.statement: The system SHALL execute AICtrlWorkflow through the canonical WorkCtrlFlow controller while using Eidolon actor/tool/material/session authorities for effects and recovery.

case.given: A canonical AICtrlWorkflow resource exists
case.when: WorkflowRun starts it
case.then: The system SHALL load its binding and execute stable nodes through WorkCtrlFlow instead of delegating one opaque prompt

case.given: A ctrl run opens an ExternalJob wait handle
case.when: WorkflowResume receives the matching signal and resume token
case.then: The persisted snapshot SHALL resume idempotently and project stable node/invocation status

case.given: Flow code invokes an embedded AI workflow effect
case.when: The host handles it
case.then: The effect SHALL use existing Eidolon actor/tool/material adapters and runtime-control evidence without copying their owned facts into workflow state

case.given: A VM is reconstructed for the same session
case.when: Status or resume loads a prior run
case.then: The controller SHALL be rebuilt from its descriptor and persisted workflow snapshot

requirement.statement: The system SHALL execute AIDataWorkflow as a persisted, per-run mutable DAG over canonical EagerDataFlow and AIDataWorkflow RunGraph semantics.

case.given: A canonical AIDataWorkflow resource exists
case.when: WorkflowRun starts it
case.then: The system SHALL persist stable nodes with inputs, outputs, config, status, results and generation

case.given: A completed or waiting run graph
case.when: A structurally valid GraphPatch is applied
case.then: The system SHALL create a new generation, record the patch and transitively invalidate affected nodes

case.given: An invalidated machine node has unchanged semantic input, config, material revisions and effect policy in the same run
case.when: The new generation advances
case.then: The system SHALL reuse the prior result without re-executing the node and SHALL retain reuse provenance

case.given: A manual node or explicit node policy resolves to never
case.when: A new generation advances
case.then: The system SHALL execute or wait again and SHALL record the policy source

case.given: A persisted graph contains completed and waiting facts
case.when: A fresh Eidolon VM queries or resumes it
case.then: The system SHALL restore the RunGraph and continue from stable node identities

requirement.statement: The system SHALL expose workflow authoring and runtime lifecycle behavior through the same native component and tool contracts across Eidolon conversation and CLI surfaces.

case.given: A workflow resource and an Eidolon workspace
case.when: A human invokes workflow run, status, events, result, resume, or graph-patch from the CLI
case.then: The CLI SHALL invoke the corresponding native workflow tool in a recoverable Eidolon session

case.given: A human describes workflow creation, execution, inspection, resume, or correction in ordinary language
case.when: The request is handled by TUI or headless conversation
case.then: The AI SHALL route it to the high-level native workflow tools without requiring XNL, internal paths, MCP, or an external agent CLI

case.given: Multiple terminal surfaces use workflow capability
case.when: They read or mutate workflow resources and runs
case.then: No surface SHALL implement a private parser, runtime, fact store, or unrestricted file-writing path

requirement.statement: The system MUST provide a complete native workflow authoring lifecycle using canonical XNL, depa-flows semantics, injected Eidolon roots and native tools.

case.given: A workflow authoring capability is implemented or claimed complete
case.when: Its acceptance evidence is inspected
case.then: The evidence MUST identify the required behavior, implementation evidence, architecture boundary and executable acceptance test

case.given: A user or author actor creates or edits a workflow
case.when: The WorkflowComponent opens an authoring session
case.then: The session MUST expose read-only base and refs mounts plus writable work and out mounts through containment-safe native operations

case.given: An authoring session has mutations, validation or dry-run facts
case.when: A later turn reloads the session
case.then: The system MUST recover its identity, mounts, current revision, proof state, target and ordered audit facts without guessing from host paths

case.given: The editable work mount contains a workflow draft
case.when: The authoring lifecycle proves it
case.then: The system MUST perform diff, canonical validate and static dry-run for one content revision and MUST support repair before publication

case.given: A validated draft is modified
case.when: Publication is requested with the prior validation revision
case.then: The system MUST reject publication until the current revision is validated and dry-run again

case.given: A draft has current successful proof
case.when: Publication is not explicitly authorized
case.then: The system MUST retain the draft and MUST NOT publish or execute it

case.given: A person describes a durable business task in ordinary language
case.when: Eidolon authors a workflow
case.then: The person MUST NOT be required to choose a workflow form, nodes, ports, reuse policy, XNL syntax or storage path

case.given: A request mixes authoring instructions with one unambiguous contiguous business payload
case.when: The workflow task input is authored
case.then: The system MUST preserve exactly that business payload while keeping authoring and lifecycle clauses outside the task

requirement.statement: The system SHALL turn an ordinary business goal into a controlled direct, AI Ctrl, AI Data or composite journey without requiring the person to understand workflow internals.

case.given: A person states a business goal in ordinary language
case.when: The native workflow experience coordinator evaluates it
case.then: The system SHALL choose direct handling, AI Ctrl, AI Data or composition and SHALL select the closest installed business scenario without asking for form, nodes, ports, policies, XNL or paths

case.given: A request is a small direct task without durable orchestration signals
case.when: The coordinator routes it
case.then: The system SHALL return it to the current Eidolon agent and SHALL NOT create a workflow merely to use workflow capability

case.given: A business goal warrants a workflow
case.when: The high-level native tool fulfills it
case.then: The system SHALL coordinate scenario context, authoring proof, input and Material inference, publication, Instance creation, execution preview and confirmed execution through existing native authorities

case.given: Authoring proof succeeds
case.when: publication or execution was not independently authorized
case.then: The system SHALL preserve a recoverable state at the corresponding gate and SHALL NOT infer the missing authorization

case.given: A normal human surface reports journey progress or completion
case.when: The result is rendered
case.then: The response SHALL describe business purpose, progress, required confirmation, waits and result without exposing form, node, port, reuse policy, XNL, FQN, fact paths or physical storage paths

case.given: The same business goal is submitted through Eidolon conversation or `eidolon workflow agent`
case.when: The journey begins
case.then: Both surfaces SHALL invoke the same native high-level tool and component-backed lifecycle rather than separate workflow logic

requirement.statement: The system MUST provide executable end-to-end evidence for the complete Eidolon workflow lifecycle across architecture, human surfaces, distribution and recovery.

case.given: The final implementation matrix is inspected
case.when: Each required behavior is evaluated
case.then: Every row MUST identify implementation evidence, an explicit architecture boundary and executable verification with no unexplained missing or partial state

case.given: Production CLI and TUI artifacts are built and installed into an isolated target
case.when: Conversation and workflow CLI capabilities are inspected or exercised
case.then: Both MUST expose the same native WorkflowFulfill journey and component-backed lifecycle without MCP or an external agent CLI

case.given: Authoring, Ctrl and Data runs have persisted facts
case.when: A fresh Eidolon runtime reads, resumes or replays them
case.then: The product MUST recover from frozen workflow facts and Eidolon-owned runtime facts without locating state by mutable graph position or host path

requirement.statement: The system MUST prove the ordinary-language workflow product through a real TUI local-runtime multi-turn journey using multiple independent public network sources before claiming the human experience complete.

case.given: A person asks in ordinary language for a reusable workflow that reads at least three explicit URLs on different real public domains and produces a combined AI trend report
case.when: The person separately confirms publication and later confirms execution through TUI conversation
case.then: The system MUST preserve a proven draft before publication, MUST publish without network access after the first confirmation, and MUST access every public source and return dynamically grounded evidence only after the second confirmation

case.given: The TUI journey is under automated acceptance
case.when: The test submits and observes the conversation
case.then: The test MUST use TuiRuntimeClient local-runtime, WorkflowFulfill, native authoring/runtime tools, persisted workflow facts, Eidolon effect execution and standard network tools rather than localhost fixtures, component-only calls or prompt-string assertions
